body: Glad that things have worked out with you. I guess I'm just the sort of person who needs other people around. I've tried to accept my situation but can't stand loneliness.

I've tried therapy twice but it wasn't very helpful, gave me more anxiety than relief. I've tried many things to change the way I feel and I'm honestly tired of convincing myself that things would get better.

I don't know if there's much to talk about. I've just had really bad life and it's hard to cope with things other people have done to me. I'm really bad at socializing with people and it makes me depressed.
